title: PCR Enrichment for NEBNext Ultra II FS DNA Library Prep Kit
author: Opentrons
materials: NEBNext Ultra II FS DNA Library Prep Kit

PCR Enrichment](http://protocols.opentrons.com/protocol/4b4a80-pcr_enrichment) With this protocol, your robot can perform the NEBNext Ultra II FS DNA Library Prep Kit for Illumina E6177S/L protocol described by the [NEBNext E6177S/L](https://www.neb.com/products/e6177-nebnext-ultra-ii-fs-dna-library-prep-with-sample-purification-beads#Product%20Information). [NEB Instruction Manual for NEBNext E6177S/L](https://s3.amazonaws.com./pf-upload-01/u-4256/0/2021-02-16/8q531ae/manualE6177-E7805.pdf). This is part 4 of the protocol: PCR enrichment This step amplifies and barcodes the size-selected output from part 3, followed by a post-PCR cleanup. This protocol assumes up to 24 input DNA samples of > 100 ng and follows Section 2 of the NEB Instruction Manual. After the pcr enrichment and cleanup steps carried out in this protocol, store samples at -20 C.

steps.title: Prepare Q5 master mix
steps.instruction: Combine the Q5 Master Mix with the i5 and i7 indexing primers, then mix thoroughly. This step is performed for up to 24 samples, each containing more than 100 ng of DNA.

substeps.instruction: Add the appropriate volume of Q5 Master Mix to a tube.

steps.title: Dispense master mix to samples
steps.instruction: Dispense the prepared master mix into each well containing the size‑selected DNA fragments and mix.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the master mix to each size‑selected sample.
Mix the reaction to ensure even distribution.

steps.title: Run PCR enrichment
steps.instruction: Place the plate in the thermocycler and run the NEBNext Ultra II FS PCR enrichment program as described in the kit manual.

substeps.instruction: Load the plate onto the thermocycler.

steps.title: Pause and relocate plate
steps.instruction: After PCR, pause the protocol, manually move the plate from the thermocycler to the magnetic module, and set up reagents for cleanup.

substeps.instruction: Manually transfer the PCR plate to the magnetic module.
Place vortexed magnetic beads on the temperature module.
Load freshly prepared 80 % ethanol and 0.1 X TE into the reagent reservoir.

steps.title: Bead cleanup and elution
steps.instruction: Perform magnetic‑bead based post‑PCR cleanup, then elute the purified library into a fresh plate.

substeps.instruction: Add magnetic beads to each well and mix.
Engage the magnets to capture the beads.
Remove ethanol and allow beads to dry briefly.
Elute DNA from the beads using 0.1 X TE buffer.
Transfer the eluate to a fresh plate.

steps.title: Store purified libraries
steps.instruction: Seal the fresh plate and store the purified DNA libraries at –20 °C.
